notes.title: A Cosmic Puzzle Journey Awaits!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39365779/28f6f6b9f1c9d8b54bc48bd5efeea6713adba01a.jpg[/img]

Squingle is a cosmic 3D puzzle game that could only exist in VR. Your challenge is to guide 2 spinning orbs to the goal through intricate, glass-like mazes called ‘squingles.’ 

Each level offers a mesmerizing visual experience, featuring dynamic, morphing sculptures that come to life in fully immersive environments or in Mixed Reality. With intuitive controls and hand-tracking support, Squingle will captivate your mind and spirit.

This MASSIVE new version has all-new visuals, progression system, voice acting, twinkles, leaderboards and more! Welcome to the new Squingle!

notes.title: Speedrun In-Game Timer Update!
notes.notes:
Having asked the speed run community what features might help them, the biggest request is for an 'in-game-clock'.  This sets the standard by not relying on external timing equipment to time your run, making it less friction to record a speed run.

To use the Speed Run Timer:

1) Turn 'story mode' to 'OFF' in the options. This stops the main character appearing every ten levels (which would just waste time!).  

2) After every 'Epoch' (group of 20 levels) - as long as you started at level 1 - the timer will appear and show your total time for that epoch.  

3) Assuming you have completed all the levels without going back to the level-select screen, or retried any levels, then your time for the whole game also gets presented at the credits at the end, as well as your scores (how many lizards and petals you collected).

Unlike the normal level times, the speed run timer is not affected by hitting the edge.

The latest update also includes our new logo design!

notes.title: For Valve Index and Knuckles users
notes.notes:
Valve Index/Knuckles hardware users have reported that the left controller won't interact in-game. I have identified the issue and will work on a fix once back at work :)

In the meantime, you [b]can roll back your version of Squingle[/b] to a previous version that has support for both Index Knuckles controllers, which I've added to a beta channel.  

To access it, in Steam, [b]go to your library, right-click on Squingle, select "Properties..." and then "BETAS".  From there, use the drop-down menu to select "Beta2 - temporary roll-back for Index users".[/b]

[b]TL:DR : Index users temporarily use the beta channel for a fix to the "left-hand-only-working" issue.[/b]

notes.title: v1.1.8 now has hand-held and first-person LIV cameras!
notes.notes:
Interested in streaming or recording Squingle?  Squingle now has custom support for LIV.  Not only does it fully support LIV's default features and plugins, including mixed reality capture, but Squingle has additional built in controls to make getting the best footage a breeze.

> Use the right stick-press to toggle between default LIV camera, first-person view, and hand-held cam (left hand controls hand held camera).

> Use the left stick-press to toggle between different camera field-of-view (FOV).

These tools, previously used internally to create awesome footage for social media and trailers, is now available to everyone with the Steam version of Squingle.

Tested on Oculus Quest 2 with Oculus Link only.

notes.title: Full LIV support enabled in v1.1.7!!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39365779/3ba47ebbe41b306ec2488c5b2bb989e585717489.png[/img]

Introducing full LIV support for Squingle.

LIV allows painless mixed reality and 3rd-person avatar capture of VR play, and it's completely free (just search LIV on Steam)

It also enables smooth camera - no more shakey camera footage for streams and videos!

SPECIAL LIV CONTROLS in Squingle

> With LIV running, you can toggle between LIV-controlled camera and a special Squingle smooth first-person camera by pressing the right joystick button press.

> With Squingle smooth first-person camera enabled, use the left stick-press to control the field-of-view for different kinds of shots!

With this set up, you can have your normal LIV orbit or 3rd person camera set, and easily switch between that and a smooth first-person viewpoint midgame at the press of a button!

notes.title: Squingle Beta 8.0 Released!!!
notes.notes:
Many thanks from the enthusiastic support from our Beta community.  We are very excited with this update, as we move towards release.

What's new?

> Visual effects and lighting
> New improved levels!
> Vastly optimized on both GPU and CPU side
> Consistency with the Oculus Quest version (to be announced).
> Statistics panel - race yourself to improve your game times.
> A ton of bug-fixes and improvements

We are moving at lightning speed now.  As always, we hope you can join the Beta program and provide your detailed feedback on the game.  Head over to our website and join our community!  www.squingle.com

We may be running some special thank you gift to the first person who can prove they have completed all the levels and provided feedback via our Beta program.

notes.title: Squingle Beta v0.5.1 Released!
notes.notes:
There are some major changes in this update - Those who return the completed beta feedback form will receive a FREE copy of the final release! Sign up for the beta at www.squingle.com now!

New in this update:

[b]> New trippy replay mode - replay your run from the perspective of inside the tube, like a roller-coaster.  It's intense so also not for those prone to cybersickness![/b] https://youtu.be/C5vOo5ssRJU
> New game mechanic: red orbs change the axis of rotation for new puzzle mechanics.
[b]> Much improved end-of-level user experience, new sound, progression, effects and rewards.[/b]
> Translucent refracting squingles - levels now refract the world around making them look like they are made of glass.
[b]> Story improvements[/b]

We are moving towards release, so there isn't time to put too much more into the game, but I do have plans for updates post-release, new content, closer Steam integration, and hopefully porting to other platforms (PSVR, Quest).  Interested in what people think I should prioritize. Join our Discord to share your wisdom!  https://discord.gg/3PV8tBU

May you be well and happy!

notes.title: Squingle Beta 0.4 Released!
notes.notes:
Squingle Beta 0.4 is now [b]LIVE[/b]! 
Here are some of the improvements as we get close to release:

[b]> Better level-progression, new levels.[/b]
> Improvement on learning curve
[b]> New physics engine for detecting collisions[/b]
> New haptics - now you can FEEL the squingles!
[b]> New water-like ripple behaviour of squingles.[/b]
> Visuals have been renovated!

As always, your feedback is more valuable than bitcoin - so keep it coming!
Thanks to everything who has been on the journey with us so far.  We love every single one of you!

If you are not yet signed up to the Beta, there has never been a better time!  Visit www.Squingle.com and get your free Steam download code now!

notes.title: Squingle Beta v0.3.1 released!
notes.notes:
Awesome feedback form our Beta testers, keep it up! New in v0.3.1

- Level curation: new ideas are presented earlier, levels have been reordered, repetition removed.
- UI enhancements - more legible and ergonomic
- Many tweaks/bug fixes.
- UI hints and some beginnings of a story added to level-complete screen.

Ideas for next release:

- more story - I'd like to bring up the main character at key times in the game to tell the story as you progress.
- more level curation and alteration based on Beta feedback (please!)
- curation of the environments and materials
- multiple save files

I'm very keen to know if you think the levels hold your attention more as they are now presented.  What are your favorite levels? Join our Beta program at www.squingle.com to join the journey!

notes.title: Squingle Beta v0.2.6 released!
notes.notes:
Direct from your Beta-feedback this release sees quality-of-life improvements:

- comfort options (environment animation off/on)
- room-scale mode for those with larger spaces - it's super fun and a visual feast at double scale!
- alternative navigation controls (grip/index-trigger grab-and-pull)
- sound and sfx volume control
- sfx improvements
- all-new haptic engine
- revamped UI and level-complete screen
- visual and shader improvements

Planned for the next release:

- deeper curation of level content
- graphical improvements
- rewards
- multiple save files (maybe)

As always, thanks so much for helping to make Squingle the best it can be!  We are working hard to bring that trippy something to VR - your feedback has been absolutely amazing!  Keep it coming and sign up if you have not already to our Beta program at 
www.squingle.com
